commentary_title: Robust activity in the UKC supports freight rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index weakened in week 34, ending at 85.6 points. Rates increased on most major routes but dipped on the Carribs-USG route. | Freight rates on UKC routes increased last week as tonnage demand exceeded the supply. Freight rates are likely to remain firm next week. | Meanwhile, the rates towards the East, especially on TD8, also saw an uptick, but with the %laden declining, rates are likely to weaken next week.
